items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...owned by Dr. Summerville... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes; I remember him.

ctx.x: I'm trying to remember when did he come on.

Can you remember the names of any of the clubs other than the Club Alabam, which was adjacent to the Dunbar Hotel, which is now a historical monument-- historical landmark, in Los Angeles. This is the hotel that was owned by Dr. Summerville, the black dentist.
